candidate.name: CCVPE_KITTI_no_orientation_prior
unresolved: exact official checkpoint file identity and byte size
faithful Full and all-scale control adapter

hypothesis: a frozen spatial matcher can localize within a visible current tile and reject outside/unrelated pairs;does not estimate outside bearing or autonomous action

preprocessing.ground_mode: aspect-preserving letterbox,bilinear resize,ImageNet-mean float padding;no FoV/rotation search
preprocessing.local_mode: evaluator cuts one125x125 tile;adapter receives only that tile and public rectangle;places it into mean-filled625x625 canvas then resizes512x512
preprocessing.deliberate_reproduction_difference: ground letterbox instead of upstream anisotropic resize;local sparse canvas instead of complete aerial scene;not paper reproduction or isolated adapter ablation
preprocessing.visible_mask: include output pixel centers only if native point lies in current tile half-open bounds

roles.known_bias: first2 images are dark;2/2 split fixed by original order,not score-based;not an independent confirmation

controls.Disabled: bypass all goal-matching maps as exact zeros before aerial decoder;do not normalize zero goal vectors or reuse hidden ground influence
controls.Mean: arithmetic mean of ground branch feature/descriptor tensors at every matching level from calibration0/1 only;no refit,developer labels or development images
controls.Wrong: fixed swap within own partition:0<->1,2<->3;original case labels unchanged

rejection.score: maximum raw finest-scale matching cosine over yaw bins and visible output pixels,not softmax maximum
rejection.accept: Python float64 score>=float64 tau;do not cast threshold to model dtype
rejection.tau_candidates: midpoints between unique calibration scores plus finite nextafter(min,-inf)/nextafter(max,+inf)

metrics.main: 2/2 positive detection+<=5m localization,per-source false accepts,goal controls and provenance
metrics.location: native parent coordinates converted with0.16m/pixel;all positive prediction error reported including rejected ones
metrics.recovery_harm: joint correct = accepted+<=5m for positives,rejected for negatives;report each class separately
metrics.source_confidence: only2 known development sources;exact4 source-resample supports,not independent statistical superiority

engineering.inputs: 4 full paired references x original/wrapper equality;privileged engineering only
engineering.invalid_or_missing_case: required completeness gate fails;do not silently drop
engineering.full_parent_geometry: diagnostic only,not part of local-screen performance or an input allowed to an Agent

resources.memory_policy: measure before main screen;never stop ComfyUI or another process;no automatic batch/model/cap increase
resources.retention: one public inference checkpoint,no optimizer;store scalar outputs and visible-region matching summaries only,not full multiyaw maps or duplicated datasets
resources.image_references_verified_now: metadata references only;real executor must verify bytes and bind decoder before first use

stop: one candidate/one calibrated threshold/one frozen screen;any failed gate closes this attempt,no tau/source/crop/architecture/seed search or autonomous-navigation/default upgrade
required_before_first_real_call: official single checkpoint strict SHA and tensor binding
